title: 謝拜油田
summary: 謝拜位於魯卜哈利沙漠；偏遠沙漠場景使熱負荷、維修運輸與庫存緩衝成為鮮明課題。本課依序分析沙漠散熱條件、偏遠備件等待、補給中斷緩衝、長距液相輸送、遠端資料完整性，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Shaybah lies in the Rub al-Khali desert, making heat load, maintenance transport and inventory buffering useful case themes. The course analyses desert heat-rejection conditions, remote spare-part waiting, supply-interruption buffer, long-distance liquid transfer, remote-data completeness, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.

v31FocusEn: Desert heat-rejection conditions; Remote spare-part waiting; Supply-interruption buffer

options: 流體溫度改變所需的顯熱是質量流率、比熱與溫差的乘積；相變或反應熱不在這個簡化式內。

steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「沙漠散熱條件」。謝拜位於魯卜哈利沙漠；偏遠沙漠場景使熱負荷、維修運輸與庫存緩衝成為鮮明課題。在「謝拜油田」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。流體溫度改變所需的顯熱是質量流率、比熱與溫差的乘積；相變或反應熱不在這個簡化式內。熱回收必須同時有熱源與可接受的冷源，不能只把兩股物流的最大溫差乘上面積就視為可用熱量。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Desert heat-rejection conditions”. Shaybah lies in the Rub al-Khali desert, making heat load, maintenance transport and inventory buffering useful case themes. In the teaching model for Shaybah oil field, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. Sensible heat duty is mass flow times specific heat times temperature change; latent and reaction heat lie outside this simplified equation. Recovery needs both a heat source and an admissible sink. A large temperature difference alone does not establish useful recovered energy or a feasible exchanger design. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 依「沙漠散熱條件」的模型 Q = m cp ΔT，「沙漠散熱條件」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。最接近下列何者？

steps.title: 沙漠散熱條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Desert heat-rejection conditions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沙漠散熱條件」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Desert heat-rejection conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = m cp ΔT；代入 m = 86 kg/s、cp = 2.2 kJ/(kg·K)、dT = 35 K，得 6.62 MW（「沙漠散熱條件」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 dT 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = m cp ΔT; with m = 86 kg/s, cp = 2.2 kJ/(kg·K), dT = 35 K the result is 6.62 MW (simplified exercise for Desert heat-rejection conditions; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise dT by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：dT 增加 10% 時，結果變為 7.28 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising dT by 10% changes the result to 7.28 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 6.62 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 dT 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 6.62 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in dT with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沙漠散熱條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。

optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For “Desert heat-rejection conditions”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis.

quiz.explanationEn: For “Desert heat-rejection conditions”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沙漠散熱條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Desert heat-rejection conditions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沙漠散熱條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Desert heat-rejection conditions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「沙漠散熱條件」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。把兩側流量與進出口溫度放入同時段熱平衡，先比較熱量是否在不確定度內相符，再檢查是否漏列相變或散熱。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Desert heat-rejection conditions”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Put both sides of the exchanger into a synchronized heat balance, compare duties within measurement uncertainty, then check for omitted phase change or ambient heat loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 004-01 標記，圖表須寫明「謝拜油田：教學假設」。把可回收熱量、出口溫度限制及未建模項列成三欄，所有溫度與比熱均使用教學假設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 004-01 and mark charts “Shaybah oil field: teaching assumptions”. Separate recoverable duty, outlet-temperature constraints and omitted effects in the report; use explicitly hypothetical temperatures and heat capacities.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「沙漠散熱條件」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Desert heat-rejection conditions” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「沙漠散熱條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Desert heat-rejection conditions" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 「沙漠散熱條件」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
冗餘設備越多就能把共因失效機率變成零。
optionsEn: An error at “Desert heat-rejection conditions” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
More redundant units reduce common-cause failure probability to zero.

quiz.explanationEn: An error at “Desert heat-rejection conditions” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 沙漠散熱條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Desert heat-rejection conditions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沙漠散熱條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Desert heat-rejection conditions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「沙漠散熱條件」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。流量計漂移、比熱取值錯誤和換熱面結垢都可能使溫差變化；只看出口溫度不能區分熱源不足與傳熱能力下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「謝拜油田」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Desert heat-rejection conditions” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Flowmeter drift, incorrect heat capacity and exchanger fouling can all alter temperatures; outlet temperature alone cannot distinguish a weaker heat source from degraded heat transfer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Shaybah oil field”.
